clips.title: The story
paras: Across the northern and central Barrens, Bristleback Quilboar Tusks are taken from slain quilboar. Mankrik gathers them as proof of slaughter and tokens of vengeance.

Bristleback quilboar defend their territory across the Barrens against Horde expansion. Their jagged ivory tusks serve as weapons in close combat. Mankrik, a veteran orc warrior stationed at the Crossroads, lost his wife in a vicious quilboar ambush. He gathers dozens of tusks as retribution, a bloody count of the suffering he means to return to the Bristlebacks.
